position.scope: All 36 complete values independently read and compared with the six complete English source messages. Review covers semantics, written idiom and script/Jyutping separately. It does not certify native-speaker review, screen layout, rendering, runtime behavior, historical linguistic purity or every dialect within a broad language tag. No processing-label repairs or unrelated strings reviewed or edited.
position.publication_condition: Acceptance is only for these exact complete UTF-8 values, bound by each target_sha256. Any changed value must be reread; sources and nonblocking uncertainty should not be represented as native certification.

own_locale_confidence.scope: Shanghai-style written Wu within the broad wuu tag. 搿、辣、浪、搭、个、勿 and 里向 are coherent with that style. This does not certify idiom across all Wu varieties; formal technical borrowings are retained.

own_nonblocking_idiom_notes.note: Shanghai-style orthography is coherent and lexically supported. The generic wuu tag covers more dialects; all-Wu naturalness is not established.

own_primary_sources.supports: Primary authored discussion by linguist 钱乃荣 of Shanghai orthography, including 搿、辣、个、勿; written locative 辣…浪 usage.

commons.scope: All 135 new Commons/import error pairs, exactly 15 assigned East Asian locale/script options. Holds earn no accepted-translation credit.
commons.reviewer: Independent AI reviewer separate from producer. Source-assisted full-value editorial review; no human/native-speaker or complete-locale certification.

requirements_reconciliation.note: The shared requirement ledger changed during review as other accepted locales were integrated. Its assigned tags, required keys, resource paths and requirements base are unchanged. Contract, implementation excerpts and all fifteen catalogue content hashes still match the reviewed draft. This is recorded, not silently treated as identical bytes.

own_primary_sources.publisher: Qian Nairong, signed article republished by People.com.cn
own_primary_sources.supports: An actual Shanghainese prose sample using 个 and negative potential syntax. It is not an attestation of every new UI construction.

general_clarifications: Current source catalogues and historical withdrawn reviews were read as context. None of their prior acceptance claims was restored.
No change is forced solely to make technical nouns different from other related languages.

hash_method: Raw UTF-8 SHA-256 has no appended newline; parsed XML entities decoded and Android escapes retained. Canonical JSON SHA-256 is separately labeled and must not be compared to raw UTF-8 hashes.
original_raw_receipt_status: Raw independent complete-value original reviews, published consolidated attestations, proposals, deltas, and common integration status remain separate.
